results.label: U1 a `<%:` pair (punctuators `<%` and `:`) in a UART command handler
results.reason: firmware must not spell a token with a digraph or a trigraph (%:, line 1499): the compiler reads `%:` as `#` and `%:%:` as `##` once phase 2 has deleted every splice, and nothing but a digraph or a trigraph puts either pair in C code outside a literal or a comment
